title: setpref
summary: Store a named preference value for the current RunMat session.

gpu_support.notes: Host-side compatibility builtin; GPU-resident inputs are gathered before execution.

description: `setpref(group, preference, value)` stores a value under a textual group and preference name for the current RunMat session. Preference values retain their RunMat class, shape, and nested structure.
behaviors: Group and preference names accept string scalars or character row vectors.
The value may use any supported datatype. All eight integer classes are cloned without changing class, shape, or payload.
Resident values gather through the owning provider before host-side session storage; the exact gathered class is retained.
Preferences currently live for the RunMat session. Durable cross-session preference storage is not yet implemented.
